exact_claim: Develop the source's requested heuristic for the fixed-character t-aspect integral of a product of Dirichlet L-functions. Candidate scope: any finite set of fixed Dirichlet characters of arbitrary fixed moduli, repeated primitive inducers allowed, and fixed nonnegative real weights; predict leading size and explicit constant for the product of absolute values to twice those weights. This is a heuristic, not a proved asymptotic.
